research:
I could only collect news up to 2026-08-22. Most page fetches were blocked by the proxy, so several facts below come from search-result summaries rather than full articles.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Yahoo Finance daily close of BZ=F. 2026-09-19 is a Saturday, so the Friday **2026-09-18** close will be used.
- 2026-08-21: the latest BZ=F close is **94.39**, from the data you supplied. I could not fetch Yahoo directly.
- Contract roll: BZ=F is a rolling front-month series. ICE Brent October 2026 normally expires on the last business day of August, so by 2026-09-18 BZ=F should be tracking the **November 2026** contract. If the curve is in backwardation, the roll alone can lower the quoted price. I did not find current spread data, so check the October/November spread.
- 2026-08-21: Fortune put Brent at about $95.29 at 8 a.m. ET. Barchart showed the October 2026 contract's daily high at 94.83. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-oil-08-21-2026/), [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/futures/quotes/CBV26)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. Prices are being driven by the US-Iran war and the closed Strait of Hormuz, so headline risk in both directions is very high.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-21: CNBC headline: "Oil prices are little changed after Iran's president indicates Tehran wants war to end soon." Barchart said crude rose as Middle East hostilities continued. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/21/oil-prices-us-iran.html), [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/futures/quotes/CBV26)
- About 2026-08-18 (a Tuesday, date not confirmed): Brent neared $92, its highest of the month, after a UAE missile alert and Trump attacks on Tehran. [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/08/oil-nears-92-uae-missile-alert-trump-claims-iran-talks-stuck)
- 2026-08-18: Trump said "no talks" with Iran were happening or scheduled and that the naval blockade "remains in full force." A regional source told CNN that Iran and Oman expected a Hormuz arrangement within days. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/18/world/live-news/iran-war-trump), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-18/trump-takes-hard-line-on-iran-as-hormuz-standoff-drags-on)
- 2026-08-17: the 60-day US-Iran truce from June ran out and Trump declined to extend it. He also threatened Oman. Brent was about $88.85. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/17/us-iran-war-trump-hormuz.html), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/17/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-12: attacks hurt hopes that Hormuz would reopen, and Brent approached $90. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/8/12/oil-prices-rise-as-attacks-dent-hopes-for-strait-of-hormuz-reopening)
- 2026-08-10/11: Iran said Hormuz would stay closed until its conditions were met, including unfreezing its funds. Brent settled at $87.72 on 08-10. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/11/oil-prices-today-us-crude-84.html), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/8/10/oil-prices-climb-as-iranian-demands-cloud-outlook-for-strait-of-hormuz)
- 2026-08-03: Trump said he had called off a strike on Iran and Brent fell 4.7% to $83.77. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-hormuz-trump-iran.html)
- 2026-07-29: Brent rose 7.9% to $90.74 after an Iranian missile attack on US forces. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/oil-prices-today-brent-wti-iran-us-hormuz.html)

## 4. Base rates
- Code baseline for 20 trading days ahead: p5 79.3, p10 85.9, p25 89.7, **p50 94.1**, p75 99.3, p90 105.7, p95 117.4.
- August 2026: Brent moved roughly from $83 (08-03) to $94.4 (08-21), a swing of about 13% in under three weeks. Single-day moves of 4% to 8% have happened repeatedly on war headlines (07-29: +7.9%; 08-03: -4.7%). In March 2026, Brent dropped about 8% in one day on "war ending soon" comments. [newsonair](https://www.newsonair.gov.in/oil-prices-fall-sharply-after-trump-says-iran-war-could-end-soon)
- Trend: rising through mid-to-late August as deal hopes faded. 94.39 is near the month's high.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-11: the EIA August STEO forecast Brent averaging about $85 in Q3 2026 and $78 in Q4, with $86.81 for full-year 2026. That points to easing prices, but the forecast was made below current levels. [S&P Global](https://www.spglobal.com/energy/en/news-research/latest-news/crude-oil/081126-us-eia-raises-brent-outlook-to-87b-on-hormuz-shipping-constraints), [Ship & Bunker](https://shipandbunker.com/news/world/111159-ship-bunker-raises-q3-bunker-price-outlook-by-100mt-after-eia-abandons-hopes-of-early-hormuz-recovery)
- Analysts warn that the war premium could vanish quickly once a Hormuz deal is reached. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/commodities/articles/oils-war-premium-could-vanish-004013222.html)
- Kalshi lists daily and weekly Brent markets, including the week ending 2026-09-18 ([kxbrentw-26sep1817](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxbrentw/brent-oil/kxbrentw-26sep1817)). I could not get prices as of 2026-08-22. I found no Polymarket or Manifold market on this question.
- I found no August 2026 bank forecast revisions, for example from Goldman.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-09-18
- US-Iran or Oman-mediated Hormuz talks: a deal could cause a sharp sell-off, while escalation, such as strikes or attacks on Gulf states and shipping, could push prices higher. The US naval blockade is still in place.
- About 2026-08-28 to 08-31: the October Brent contract expires and BZ=F rolls to November.
- Early September: OPEC+ monthly meeting (exact date not confirmed).
- About 2026-09-09: EIA September STEO. Mid-September: OPEC and IEA monthly oil reports (dates not confirmed).
- About 2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting (date not confirmed).
- Weekly EIA inventory reports every Wednesday. US commercial crude stocks are below the five-year low.
